name: Jar wine
summary: Rượu cần is the jar wine at the Bản Đôn campfire, with xòe and khắp. The same wine is among the goods at Phố Đoàn. It is not a bar pour. The price is Check on arrival.
origin: The Thanh Hoa Department of Culture, Sports and Tourism: Bản Đôn article, 18 Mar 2022, and the Phố Đoàn article, 16 May 2022.
howToEat: Shared at the evening fire in Bản Đôn. A straw ritual was not printed.
Buy a jar on Thursday or Sunday at Phố Đoàn. A stall clock is Check on arrival.
where: Bản Đôn in the evening, and Phố Đoàn on market day.
